description: App-only: create an Inbox interview and return a presigned R2 upload URL (or multipart upload_id for large files). Pass interview_id (+ upload_id for multipart) to resume without a new card.

interview_id.description: Optional: existing empty interview UUID — resume upload without creating a new card.

title.description: Optional interview title (defaults to sanitized filename).

upload_id.description: Optional multipart upload id from a previous prepare (resume).

name: mcp_prepare_upload
title: Prepare Upload
